entities.name: 隐式类型转换

entities.name: INT()
entities.description: 将数据类型转换为整数，任何小数部分都被移除。

entities.name: FLOAT()

entities.name: STR()

entities.name: 溢出错误
entities.description: 当值太大而无法存储时发生的错误。
